create_batched_inputs: create batched tensor inputs from PyTorch tensors by wrapping them with vmap batch dimensions and validating in_dims compatibility
unwrap_batched_outputs: unwrap batched tensor outputs by removing vmap batch dimensions and reconstructing original output structure
validate_batch_size: validate that all tensors to be batched have the same size in the mapped dimension before vmap execution
wrap_function_for_vmap: wrap a PyTorch function with vmap to automatically vectorize it over batched tensor inputs without explicit loops
validate_vmap_outputs: validate that a vmap-wrapped function returns only Tensors and not mixed Python types in its outputs
